integrity.computational_scope: 41615 exact-rational assertions on 640 parameter triples, not proof for all real parameters

scientific_limitations: Only scalar deterministic four-season unharvested Beverton–Holt dynamics with constant growth and exactly two copies of each of two positive capacities.
The comparison concerns asymptotic orbit means and extrema; it does not imply noisy persistence, harvest yield or observed field performance.
Novelty is assessed against inspected literature; later full texts remain inaccessible and independent priority assessment is outstanding.
title: A strict inverse-biomass majorization law for four-season Beverton–Holt populations
